name: Shounai Otohime
source:
An erotic princess who welcomes people that comes to the Ryuuguu Castle.
It seems that if you stay in Ryuuguu for a long time, you will be corrupted by the luxury and entertainment from her.
Those who return to the ground will be handed a treasure according to the length of stay and Urashima's casket (in the story of Urashima Tarou).
